prompt:
A cinematic storyboard sheet for a Sri Lankan television drama: 9 photorealistic film stills of ONE scene, laid out in a grid 3 panels across and 3 down, read left to right, then top to bottom. Every panel is a tall portrait 9:16 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same scene's world, painted together: the same people, props, light and colour grade in every panel. The weather and the ground (dry or wet, rain falling or not) are as each panel says: they can change during the scene, and a panel that says it is dry has no rain and no wet ground.

Reference images, in order: image 1 is the location plate for Colombo roadside; image 2 is the reference sheet for phone. Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Kasun is the red mannequin; Anudi is the blue mannequin; Father is the yellow mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): One painted storyboard image arranged four panels across and three down, with eleven vertical panels in shot order and the bottom-right cell left blank. Use plain gutters, with no lettering, labels, symbols or arrows. Kasun is a medium-height, lean red artist's mannequin; Anudi is an average-height, slender blue artist's mannequin, both smooth and unmarked. Render the setting and props realistically. Soft overcast early-morning daylight, wet patched asphalt, damp concrete pavement and open kerb drainage remain consistent throughout; no rain is falling. Keep a restrained grey-green grade, gentle warm highlights and subdued amber light from the food three-wheeler. Anudi's handset has an orange back, a transparent protective case and a black front. Her navy folding umbrella stays open, its shaft held in her left hand; her structured tan handbag, with brass-coloured fittings, hangs by its strap from her right shoulder. Maintain the same mannequin proportions, props and light across all panels.

Geography: The narrow pavement runs horizontally through the scene, with the road and open drain along its camera-facing edge. Kasun's compact food three-wheeler occupies the vending bay at screen left, beneath a faded blue shop awning with warm light underneath; this awning is the recurring landmark. Behind the bay are weathered shop shutters, while a pale green building section and stained concrete boundary wall extend toward screen right along Anudi's departure path. Kasun stands left of their conversation gap, with the three-wheeler behind and farther left; Anudi stands on the right. Every camera remains on the roadward side of their line, looking toward the pavement and frontages. The departure continues laterally toward screen right along this same pavement, never away into depth.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Roadward side, looking across the pavement toward the pair; standing head height, 35mm feel, stable vertical two-shot from mid-thigh up. Background: The three-wheeler and faded blue shop awning sit behind Kasun on frame left, with amber light under the awning. The pale green frontage and stained boundary wall occupy frame right; pavement and the drain edge cross the bottom. The red mannequin stands screen left, chest and head turned three-quarter right, extending its far-side right hand toward the centre with the orange handset still in its grip. Its empty near-side left hand rests beside its waist. The blue mannequin stands screen right, chest and head turned three-quarter left toward red, with its near-side right hand open just short of receiving the handset. Blue's far-side left hand holds the umbrella shaft at waist height beneath the open canopy, while the tan bag hangs at its near, camera-facing right hip.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Roadward side, close to the opening two-shot position; standing head height, 40mm feel, chest-up medium framing of both mannequins with extra space at left. Background: The faded blue awning and softly defined three-wheeler remain frame left, with warm light underneath. Pale green frontage fills the right background, and the navy umbrella canopy enters the upper-right corner. Red occupies screen left with its chest facing right and its head turned three-quarter right toward blue. Blue occupies screen right with its chest and head turned three-quarter left toward red, not yet turned toward the business. Below the crop, red's empty hands rest near its waist, while blue holds the phone low in its near-side right hand and the umbrella shaft in its far-side left hand; the tan bag strap remains visible over blue's near shoulder.
PANEL 3 (row 1, column 3) — Roadward side on the established shared axis; standing head height, 40mm feel, waist-up two-shot at the opening width. Background: The three-wheeler's serving edge and faded blue awning remain behind red on frame left. The pale green frontage and concrete wall remain behind blue on frame right, with the umbrella canopy above that side. Red stands left with relaxed arms, chest facing right and head turned three-quarter right toward blue, both empty hands resting near its waist. Blue stands right with its chest facing left and its head turned three-quarter left toward red. Blue holds the handset at waist height in its near-side right hand and the umbrella shaft in its far-side left hand, with the tan bag against its near right hip.
PANEL 4 (row 2, column 1) — Roadward side, offset toward Anudi's end of the conversation gap; standing upper-chest camera height looking slightly upward, 75mm feel, medium close-up of red. Background: A soft fragment of the faded blue awning and warm three-wheeler light stays frame left. Weathered shopfront texture dissolves behind red toward frame right; blue is outside the frame to the right. Red fills the panel from upper torso upward, its chest angled screen right and its head turned three-quarter right toward blue's off-frame position. Its shoulders remain level and its torso upright. Both empty hands are below the lower crop near its waist.
PANEL 5 (row 2, column 2) — Roadward side, offset toward Kasun's end of the gap; standing head height, 65mm feel, mid-torso medium shot of blue with space on frame left. Background: The pale green frontage and worn boundary wall soften behind blue on frame right. A blurred fragment of the faded blue shop awning remains at far left, and the navy umbrella canopy clips the top-right edge. Blue stands right of centre, chest facing screen left and head turned three-quarter left toward red outside the frame, with its shoulders relaxed. Its near-side right hand holds the handset low, just inside the lower edge, without lifting or inspecting it. Its far-side left hand holds the umbrella shaft below the crop, and the tan bag strap crosses the near shoulder.
PANEL 6 (row 2, column 3) — Roadward side above the handset, looking slightly downward; approximately waist-to-chest camera height, 100mm macro feel, tight insert with the phone filling most of the panel. Background: Wet pavement is a soft grey blur behind the phone, with a fragment of the three-wheeler's dark wheel at far left and pale concrete toward frame right. The shop awning remains outside the crop to frame left. The black, unlit phone front fills the centre, angled slightly toward the camera, with a narrow orange edge visible through its transparent case. Blue's right hand supports it from the lower-right edge, smooth fingers wrapped around the sides. The display contains only faint ambient reflections, with no caller image or interface visible.
PANEL 7 (row 3, column 1) — Roadward side toward Kasun's end of the gap, viewing blue's right side; standing head height, 65mm feel, medium close-up. Background: Soft pale green wall fills frame right, while the faded blue shop awning remains a blurred fragment at far left. The navy umbrella canopy crosses the upper-right background. Blue fills the right side of the panel, chest still facing screen left and head tipped down in three-quarter view toward the handset. Its near-side right forearm is bent, holding the phone at the lower edge with the display directed toward blue rather than the camera, not yet against its head. Its far-side left hand remains below the crop around the umbrella shaft, with the tan bag strap visible on the near shoulder.
PANEL 8 (row 3, column 2) — Roadward side on the same side as shot 7; standing head height, 75mm feel, tight medium close-up of blue's head and upper torso. Background: The pale green wall becomes a soft field on frame right, with a muted blue-and-amber trace of the shop awning at far left. The underside of the navy umbrella occupies the upper-right edge. Blue's chest remains angled screen left, with its head upright and turned three-quarter left, held still. Its near-side right hand presses the phone against the right side of its head, leaving the orange back and transparent case visible toward the camera. Its far-side left hand remains below the crop holding the umbrella shaft, while a short section of tan bag strap enters at the near shoulder.
PANEL 9 (row 3, column 3) — Roadward side at the shared master position; standing head height, 40mm feel, locked waist-up two-shot. Background: The three-wheeler and faded blue awning return clearly on frame left behind red. Pale green frontage and the stained wall remain on frame right behind blue, with the open umbrella above blue. Red stands screen left with its chest facing right and its head turned three-quarter right toward blue, both empty hands resting low near its waist. Blue stands screen right with its chest facing left and its head held three-quarter left, its near-side right hand still holding the phone against the right side of its head. Blue's far-side left hand grips the umbrella shaft at waist height, and the tan bag rests against its near right hip.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
